MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14'), '/', '-') AS DATE) AS end_date,
  CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) AS birth_date
WITH p,
  date_part('year', end_date) - date_part('year', birth_date) - CASE WHEN date_part('month', end_date) < date_part('month', birth_date) OR (date_part('month', end_date) = date_part('month', birth_date) AND date_part('day', end_date) < date_part('day', birth_date)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(split_part(p.death_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) END AS end_year,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(split_part(p.death_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) END AS end_month,
  CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 14 ELSE CAST(split_part(p.death_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) END AS end_day
WITH p,
  end_year - birth_year - CASE
    WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day) THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
